notes.subject: bel bilong mi
notes.rationale: נפשי here is 'my life', not 'my feelings'; bel is the fixed Tok Pisin gloss for נפש.

notes.subject: יבשו/ויחפרו
notes.rationale: Two near-synonym shame verbs bracket the verse in parallel pairs (ashamed/confounded… turned back/abashed); Tok Pisin repeats sem with intensifiers, losing the distinct roots.

translation: Ol i mas sem na ol i mas kapsait sem long ol i painim bel bilong mi; ol i mas go bek bihain na ol i mas sem tru, ol i tingting long bagarapim mi.

tokens.gloss: na ol i mas kapsait sem
na ol i mas sem tru
